channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: GFN.TV Interviews #98 | CRITICAL MASS | Global Safer Nicotine Use Reaches 200 Million
item.description: An estimated 200 million people worldwide now use safer nicotine products, according to the latest GSTHR Situation Report, with global vaping numbers nearly doubling over the past five years. (Published on November 20, 2026bygfn.tv)

item.title: Is Vaping as Harmful to Blood Vessels as Smoking? Yes, Says a Study… of 17 Vapers
item.description: A cardiovascular study involving just 17 vapers has drawn criticism from independent experts over claims that vaping may be as harmful to blood vessels as smoking. (Published on November 20, 2026byvapingpost.com)

item.title: 16 MEPs urge EU to ban vape flavours and disposables
item.description: Sixteen Members of the European Parliament are calling for an EU-wide ban on vape flavours and disposable e-cigarettes, alongside a freeze on new nicotine products. (Published on November 20, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)
